thread.title: 8 Biggest Price Target Changes For Monday

author: Lisa Levin
title: 8 Biggest Price Target Changes For Monday
text: Lisa Levin , Benzinga Staff Writer {{following ? "Following" : "Follow"}} April 30, 2018 9:46am Comments Share: Citigroup boosted Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. (NYSE: APD ) price target from $185 to $198. Air Products and Chemicals shares closed at $165.02 on Friday. Stifel Nicolaus lowered Mohawk Industries, Inc. (NYSE: MHK ) price target from $300 to $290. Mohawk Industries shares closed at $217.36 on Friday. Barclays raised Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX ) price target from $105 to $115. Phillips 66 shares closed at $111.34 on Friday. KeyBanc increased the price target for Eastman Chemical Company (NYSE: EMN ) from $118 to $122. Eastman Chemical shares closed at $104.60 on Friday. Barclays lowered the price target for Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) from $168 to $157. Apple shares closed at $162.32 on Friday. JMP Securities increased the price target on SVB Financial Group (NASDAQ: SIVB ) from $290 to $345. SVB Financial shares closed at $305.61 on Friday. BMO Capital cut the price target for Dover Corporation (NYSE: DOV ) from $118 to $115. Dover shares closed at $95.34 on Friday. Buckingham cut the price target on Charter Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHTR ) from $425 to $397. Charter Communications shares closed at $263.325 on Friday. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice. All rights reserved.
